problem: Native RTF OLE result pictures were skipped when enclosed by Word character-format groups, losing previews from canonical output. DOC exposed only editor-managed field references through its embedded-object inventory, so native ObjectPool storages needed a separate read-only view.
changes: Add embedded_object::Storage/Storages aliases and Snapshot::storages() borrowing every discovered ObjectPool storage. Preserve the distinct managed-field ownership contract; no native field references are invented.

Parse nested object-result formatting groups with bounded, restored Result states and current-font decoding. Retain preferred/nonshppict preview wrappers on EmbeddedObject in result-picture order, outside body picture-compatibility records.

Carry result_picture_wrappers through owning conversion, canonical writing and checked transfer. Unknown result destinations retain Drawing scope and block lossy canonical publication; malformed/deep wrappers are errors.

Add eight native owner/facade tests and three synthetic object-result regressions. Add tempfile dev dependencies for temporary output tests. Reconcile four previously unasserted feature rows with bounded assertion scopes.

verification_scope.doc_group: Exact OfficeArt group 1026, bounds 3048000x1714500, three children 1027-1029 with Rectangle/AutoShape/TextBox kinds, native types 1/2/202, exact anchors, blue/yellow fills, SVG_MARKER_007 carriage-return text, 12 unknown root properties and retained container sizes.
verification_scope.doc_objects: Read-only storage view exposes _1853584064/_1853584157 with Microsoft Excel Worksheet/Chart CompObj names, exact ObjInfo flag expectations, 18372-byte XLSX SHA-256 and separate 30785-byte chart Workbook stream. A body edit preserves all typed and unknown object metadata/payloads through temporary save/reopen and exact inverse.
verification_scope.rtf_objects: Excel.Sheet.12 and Excel.Chart.8 objdata retain exact lengths 39153/42730 and hashes. OLE1 headers have version 0x501/format 2, exact class names and native CFB lengths 20992/34816 with separately recorded hashes. Each result has preferred/fallback preview ownership, retained by canonical writing and transfer into an ordinary generated receiver; chart size/scales are exact.
verification_scope.rtf_vector: Four picture entries form two byte-identical PNG preferred/fallback pairs, despite declared Png/Wmf types; lengths 10853/15111, hashes and raw size controls are exact. The sole structural opaque node is field-scoped defshp in an empty default-picture destination. Canonical output refuses with the exact InvalidInput reason before writing bytes.
verification_scope.rtf_boundaries: Exact snapshot save/reopen preserves both visual RTF files. Ordinary-run edit commit returns UnsupportedContent for dependent picture/object/field owners and leaves the source untouched. The ordinary-root transfer API refuses the native minimal receiver because it contains opaque destinations; the positive receiver is a generated ordinary RTF root, not a modified native fixture.
verification_scope.synthetic: Nested Shift-JIS/current-font text, restored Windows-1252 and Unicode fallback scopes, two compatibility previews, no body-picture wrapper leakage and exact cached text survive writing. Unknown result destinations retain Drawing ownership and refuse canonical loss; malformed wrapper syntax, missing/extra pictures and excessive nesting fail.
verification_scope.facade: Explicit DOC ObjectPool and RTF OLE1/CFB extraction opens both worksheet payloads as XLSX, checks Sales chart/Sheet1/Sheet2 and stored SUM(B2:B5)=14 / Sheet1!D6=49.75 caches, and preserves caches through independent child edits. Parent and original child bytes remain unchanged.
verification_scope.validation: Complete DOC/RTF owners, affected DOC/RTF operations and eight-format facade pass. Clippy, targeted formatting, 72 Python tests, corpus integrity and CI configuration checks pass. Three pre-existing tests remain ignored for external fixture/probe-output reasons.
verification_scope.environment: Original fixtures and three pre-existing untracked files remain unchanged. No native Office reopen, rendering, object activation, macro execution, source refresh or formula calculation occurred.
